question: Gaaffii
defaultDirections: Deebii gaaffii kanaaf deebii ta'a jettee yaaddu fili. Yeroo xumurte, {checkAnswer} tuqi. Sirrummaa deebii keetii fi akkamitti itti fufuu akka qabdu kan agarsiisu duub deebii ni argatta.
relatedContentDescription: Kun qabiyyee gaaffii kana wajjin walqabatuuf bakka cufamaa uuma, yeroo hundas ni mul'ata
hintDescription: Kun yoo fayyadamaan deebii dogoggore ni dhiyaata
evidenceDescription: Kun yoo fayyadamaan deebii sirrii argate ni dhiyaata
markTheWordsDirections: Jechoota ilaallatan {selectAll}. Sana booda deebii kee qoruuf {checkAnswer} tuqi. Sirrummaa deebii keetii kan agarsiisu duub deebii ni argatta.
